message.jaymospowers.elemental.warning_1: You are angering things you cannot defend yourself from.
Something old has turned its eye on you. It does not blink.
The air goes still around you, the way it does before a storm.
You have been noticed by those who lent you this. They are not pleased.
Blood on a borrowed gift. The lender remembers.
message.jaymospowers.elemental.warning_2: We will not stand for injustice in our name.
Twice now. We gave you this. We did not give you leave to murder.
You wear our gift like a butcher's apron. Once more, and we take it back.
We are watching your hands. They are not clean.
Do you think the element forgets whose it is? We do not.
message.jaymospowers.elemental.reclaim: You have enraged the Gods of your power and they now reclaim it
message.jaymospowers.elemental.taken: The wrath passes. Your power is gone from you.
message.jaymospowers.elemental.returned_: Your power stirs in you again. It is still not clean.
Your power stirs in you again, clean.
message.jaymospowers.elemental.penance: The draught burns going down. Somewhere, something old accepts it.
